title: Germany at the World Cup
description: Four stars, eight finals — Germany (and West Germany) at the World Cup.

questions.q: How many World Cups have Germany (incl. West Germany) won?
The 1954 final win over Hungary is known as the…
questions.explain: West Germany's shock 3–2 win is the 'Miracle of Bern'.

questions.q: Whose goal won Germany the 2014 final against Argentina?
Which German is the World Cup's all-time top scorer?
Franz Beckenbauer won the World Cup as a player and as what?
questions.explain: He won in 1974 as captain and 1990 as manager.

questions.q: Germany suffered group-stage exits in which two recent World Cups?
questions.explain: Holders in 2018, they went out in the group in both 2018 and 2022.

questions.q: West Germany hosted and won the World Cup in which year?
questions.explain: They beat the Netherlands in the 1974 final on home soil.

questions.q: Which country has reached the most World Cup finals (8)?
questions.explain: Germany have appeared in eight finals, a record.

questions.q: Manuel Neuer won which award at the 2014 World Cup?
questions.explain: Neuer won the Golden Glove for the tournament's best goalkeeper at Brazil 2014, having revolutionised the role with his sweeper-keeper play.

questions.q: Who scored the winner for West Germany in the 1974 World Cup final against the Netherlands?
questions.explain: Gerd Müller scored the decisive 2–1 winner four minutes from time, completing West Germany's comeback after the Netherlands had taken an early lead.
